dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea : Health Facilities (OpenStreetMap Export)
dct_description_sm: Health facilities from OSM. Includes hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, doctors, and dentists tagged via `amenity` or `healthcare`. Useful for service-access analysis, emergency response, and healthcare gap mapping. OpenStreetMap is a free, collaborative world map built by volunteers. Completeness varies by region: urban areas are usually well-mapped, remote areas may be incomplete. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org) - OSM tags: [Key:amenity](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:amenity), [Key:healthcare](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:healthcare) - Part of many [exports grid on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot) by the [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/en/)
